headline: Treasury yields rise again to end a volatile week
detail: Rising Treasury yields can make growth stocks, like many in your tech/chip portfolio, less attractive as they increase borrowing costs and discount future earnings more heavily. This could put pressure on your holdings.
rec: Consider reviewing stops on your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and other tech holdings like SMH, as rising yields could exacerbate drawdowns.
